 Ash

Van Cleef Asset Managementinc decreased its stake in Oracle Corp (ORCL) by 94.89% based on its latest 2018Q2 regulatory filing with the SEC. Van Cleef Asset Managementinc sold 161,648 shares as the company’s stock rose 2.22% with the market. The institutional investor held 8,701 shares of the prepackaged software company at the end of 2018Q2, valued at $383,000, down from 170,349 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Van Cleef Asset Managementinc who had been investing in Oracle Corp for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $193.87B market cap company. The stock increased 1.07% or $0.54 during the last trading session, reaching $51.17. About 20.93 million shares traded or 12.62% up from the average. Oracle Corporation (NYSE:ORCL) has declined 6.50% since November 17, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 22.12% the S&P500.
Analysts await Oracle Corporation (NYSE:ORCL) to report earnings on December, 13. They expect $0.70 earnings per share, up 12.90 % or $0.08 from last year’s $0.62 per share. ORCL’s profit will be $2.65B for 18.28 P/E if the $0.70 EPS becomes a reality. After $0.62 actual earnings per share reported by Oracle Corporation for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts 12.90 % EPS growth.
